description: Create a new listing in the Tulimoa directory on behalf of the authenticated user, with the same fields and rules as the web form (https://tulimoa.com/submit/guidelines): AI or MCP software with its own website, the user's own product, at most 2 active listings per account. It starts as 'pending' and is reviewed by hand. Required: logo_url and ai_usage (how the software uses AI or what agents can do with it). Choose how it goes live with `visibility`: 'badge' (free; the Tulimoa badge must already be on the website, this tool checks it) or 'launch' ($5 one-time, no badge, reviewed first, refunded if rejected). For 'launch' ask the user for consent and pass withdrawal_consent: true; the result has a checkout_url the user opens to pay. Optional fields match the form: gallery, content blocks, founding year, team size, demo and docs links, data points, X handles and a test request. A website that is already listed cannot be submitted again. Use list_categories first to pick a valid category id. Requires a write-scoped Tulimoa login.

agent_interfaces.description: Optional: other ways agents can use it (api, cli, sdk, webhooks).

ai_usage.description: Required, 40 to 600 characters, ideally in English: how the software uses AI, or what agents can do with it. Be concrete, not salesy. Submissions without a clear AI or agent angle are rejected.

category.description: One category id. Call list_categories for valid ids.

content_blocks.description: Optional profile sections, like in the web form. type: long_description (max 600 chars), ideal_for, not_for, key_features (one feature per line, 5 to 10 lines, max 600), use_cases, integrations (comma-separated). Max 400 chars unless noted. Several blocks of the same type are allowed. Write in English. On edit, the list replaces all blocks.

subject.description: Only for ideal_for and not_for: the short audience after 'Ideal for' / 'Not for', e.g. 'small SaaS teams'.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code of the company's HQ, e.g. DE. Same list as the web form.

data_region.description: Optional. Where customer data is hosted: eu (in the EU by default), eu-option (an EU region can be selected), non-eu, self-hosted (runs at the customer). Listings with EU hosting also appear on tulimoa.com/mcp-eu.

gallery_captions.description: Optional captions for gallery_urls, same order, max 120 chars each.

gallery_urls.description: Optional screenshots, up to 5 public https image URLs (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, max 10 MB each). The first one is the hero image. Tulimoa scales them to max 1280 px and stores them as WebP. Images already stored on Tulimoa (from get_listing) are kept as they are.

gdpr_dpa.description: Optional: a GDPR data processing agreement (DPA) is available.

hosting_provider.description: Optional hosting provider and location, e.g. 'Hetzner, Falkenstein'.

launch_hook.description: Launch package with welcome post: one sentence why the tool matters (max 140 chars, English).

logo_url.description: Required. Public https URL of the company logo: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, at least 64 px, max 10 MB. A square icon works best. Tulimoa downloads it, scales it to max 512 px and stores it as WebP.

mcp.description: true = this tool exposes its own MCP server.

mcp_auth.description: Only if mcp is true: how agents connect (oauth, api). Empty = no auth.

mcp_docs_url.description: Only if mcp is true: link to the MCP docs.

mcp_server_url.description: Only if mcp is true: endpoint URL of the MCP server (e.g. .../mcp).

model_source.description: Optional: which AI models (own, open-weight, provider, mixed, none).

open_source.description: Optional: the software is open source.

pricing_model.description: Pricing model (required): free | freemium | paid | lifetime.

short_description.description: One-line pitch (max 300 chars), ideally in English.

test_access.description: Test request only: a trial link or promo code; the test says so if access was given.

test_note.description: Test request only: what the tester should look at.

test_request.description: Optional: ask Florian to test the tool by hand (about an hour with a real account; result goes on the listing, on X and into the weekly Radar, including what is missing). Free for now, no right to a test or a date.

test_x_handle.description: Test request only: the submitter's X handle, to tag them and ask questions.

trains_on_customer_data.description: Optional: trains on customer data (no, opt-out, yes).

url.description: The product's own website (http or https). A marketplace page or an app-store-only app is not accepted.

visibility.description: How the listing goes live (required). 'badge' = free: the Tulimoa badge must ALREADY be embedded on the product website; this tool checks the page and refuses the badge route without it (the error returns the badge HTML to embed). Reviewed within 7 days. If the badge is missing for 7 days later on, the listing is deleted unless the badge is back or the launch package is booked. 'launch' = $5 one-time launch package: no badge needed, reviewed first, optional welcome post on X, refunded automatically if rejected. Ask the user which one they want.

withdrawal_consent.description: Required (true) for visibility 'launch'. Only set it after the user agrees: Tulimoa starts the review right away, the right of withdrawal ends once the listing is live, and a rejected listing gets the $5 back automatically.

x_post_opt_in.description: Launch package only: a free welcome post on X after approval. Needs launch_hook and at least one X handle.

name: submit_listing

badge_html.description: Badge route only: the badge HTML (light = for dark backgrounds, dark = for light backgrounds). Keep it on the site.

badge_verified.description: true = the Tulimoa badge was found on the website.

checkout_url.description: Launch package only: opens the Polar checkout (Tulimoa login needed).

manage_url.description: Dashboard page for status, badge check and payment.

next_step.description: What the user has to do now.

slug.description: Final slug (may carry a conflict suffix).

test_requested.description: true = a hand test was requested.

title: Submit an AI or MCP tool to the Tulimoa directory
